## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] I added or updated tests and ran `npm run check`.
- [ ] E2E is relevant and passed, or is not required because no real sandbox lifecycle changed.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-visible behavior, or documentation is not needed.
- [ ] I reviewed any security boundary impact against `SECURITY.md` and `THREAT_MODEL.md`.
- [ ] I verified data preservation and failure paths; this change cannot silently lose retained work.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` for a user-visible change, or a changelog entry is not needed.
- [ ] I included no secrets, credentials, private source, raw environment dumps, or sensitive patches.

## Notes

Call out compatibility limits, manual checks, and follow-up work.
